items.source: Build the BeanWiringInfo for the given Configurable annotation.
items.translation: 为给定的Configurable注解构建BeanWiringInfo。

items.source:
The default implementation returns the superclass name for a CGLIB
proxy and the name of the plain bean class else.
items.translation: 默认实现为 CGLIB 代理返回父类名称，否则返回普通 Bean 类的名称。

items.source: BeanWiringInfoResolver that uses the Configurable annotation to identify which classes need autowiring. The bean name to look up will be taken from the Configurable annotation if specified; otherwise the default will be the fully-qualified name of the class being configured.
items.translation: 使用 `BeanWiringInfoResolver` 接口来识别哪些类需要自动装配，该接口利用 `Configurable` 注解。要查找的 Bean 名称将从指定的 `Configurable` 注解中获取；否则，默认值为正在配置的类的完全限定名。

items.source: Resolve the BeanWiringInfo for the given bean instance.
items.translation: 解析给定 Bean 实例的 BeanWiringInfo。
`resolveWiringInfo` 在接口 `BeanWiringInfoResolver` 中

items.source: beanInstance - the bean instance to resolve info for
items.translation: beanInstance - 要解析信息的 Bean 实例

items.source: the BeanWiringInfo, or null if not found
annotation - the Configurable annotation found on the bean class
items.translation: annotation - 在 Bean 类上找到的 Configurable 注解

items.source: beanInstance - the bean instance to build a default name for
items.translation: beanInstance - 要为其构建默认名称的 Bean 实例

items.source: the default bean name to use
items.translation: 要使用的默认 Bean 名称

items.source: Determine the default bean name for the specified bean instance.
items.translation: 确定指定 Bean 实例的默认 Bean 名称。
